**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear Miss Yonge,
Don’t you think that an Index and some chronological tables would be of similar use to the [Cameos](../books.html#73)?

If you agree with [me](../persons.html#939) I can get them done.

The printer is making a table of contents of which you shall see a proof.
I enclose a letter about the terrible story(?).

But I think the [Little Duke](../books.html#20) has been close and [rest of paragraph indecipherable]
I hope you like the gilt-edged copy of the [Pupils](../books.html#72).

Yours very faithfully
A.

Macmillan

[^1]: Although dated earlier than the previous letter from Macmillan, this letter is placed after it in the Macmillan letter book
